lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Security, please confirm the east doors.

lines.speaker: mallCop
lines.text: East doors. Confirmed.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Driver for Kern Valley, please pull to Dock B.

lines.speaker: biker
lines.text: Midnight pickup. Cash. Don't ask.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Paging Champ. Your party is at the fountain.

lines.speaker: skater
lines.text: ...Who still says 'champ'?

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Photo order 1854, please come to Guest Services.

lines.speaker: mallGoth
lines.text: Nobody picks up a photo order at midnight.

lines.speaker: skater
lines.text: Guys? ...Guys. Get up.

lines.speaker: news
lines.text: A refinery leak. Stay indoors. Keep windows shut.

lines.speaker: mallCop
lines.text: Refinery's nine miles off. They knew in three minutes?

lines.speaker: radio
lines.text: Vector Control base. How many survivors, Officer?

lines.speaker: mallCop
lines.text: Four.

lines.speaker: radio
lines.text: Hold position. Help is coming.

lines.speaker: skater
lines.text: Four thousand dropped. Why are we four still standing?

lines.speaker: biker
lines.text: Ask later, dock rat.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Shoppers, please remain where you are. Help is on the way.

lines.speaker: skater
lines.text: Everybody dropped, man. Why didn't we?

lines.speaker: mallCop
lines.text: Every shutter just dropped. Our only route out is the Food Court.

lines.speaker: biker
lines.text: Food Court's packed with hungry dead. Good. So's my chainsaw.

lines.speaker: news
lines.text: Refinery leak reported. Residents, stay indoors.

lines.speaker: mallGoth
lines.text: Or we hijack the PA. The customers go where the noise is.

lines.speaker: skater
lines.text: Dudes. Escalator's eating a guy. Pick in like ten seconds.

lines.speaker: mallCop
lines.text: Gate first. Nothing gets behind us. That's Section Four.

lines.speaker: biker
lines.text: Slow. Boring. Fine, Badge. I'm first through the door.

lines.speaker: mallGoth
lines.text: One bass drop and they'll follow it anywhere. Like boys at a show.

lines.speaker: mallCop
lines.text: Copy. Keep it under a noise complaint, please.

lines.speaker: biker
lines.text: THAT'S the plan! Somebody hold the door. Never mind, I'll make one.

lines.speaker: mallCop
lines.text: For the record, I hate this plan.

lines.speaker: skater
lines.text: Okay, nobody? Cool. Cool cool cool. Running in anyway.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Shoppers, please remain where you are. Thank you.

lines.speaker: ray
lines.text: Hey! Pizza guy, still alive! Vern's gone nuts back there!

lines.speaker: ray
lines.text: Bug guys ate here at 11:30. Said you let 'em up, Officer.

lines.speaker: skater
lines.text: Wait. Badge let the bug guys in?

lines.speaker: mallCop
lines.text: That's... a routine fogging order. I checked a badge.

lines.speaker: mallGoth
lines.text: Huh. They'd rather listen to me. Finally.

lines.speaker: ray
lines.text: Guys! Counter's caving! I'm pinned, I'm pinned!

lines.speaker: mallCop
lines.text: Security Locker's fire-sealing in ten. Last heavy gear in the mall.

lines.speaker: biker
lines.text: Pizza or payload. Can't carry both.

lines.speaker: mallGoth
lines.text: ...He gave me garlic knots. Every night. For a year.

lines.speaker: biker
lines.text: Hang on, Pizza. Lifting with my back. Like a genius.

lines.speaker: ray
lines.text: I'm out! I'm out! Somebody kiss the Biker!

lines.speaker: mallCop
lines.text: Copy. Gear secured. ...Ray, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: mallGoth
lines.text: Don't. Don't talk to me for a while.

lines.speaker: skater
lines.text: Holding it! Holding it! Dude, my arms are spaghetti!

lines.speaker: ray
lines.text: Got... most of me out. Most is good, right?

lines.speaker: ray
lines.text: Guys? GUYS?

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Attention. The Food Court is now closed. Thank you.

lines.speaker: biker
lines.text: ...Huh. Seen those before.

lines.speaker: mallCop
lines.text: Vector Control cans. Same as the work order I signed.

lines.speaker: butcher
lines.text: Welcome to Toller's!

lines.speaker: butcher
lines.text: Officer. They pulled my filter.

lines.speaker: mallCop
lines.text: Ray's safe. Now we close this kitchen.

lines.speaker: biker
lines.text: Order up, Vern.

lines.speaker: mallGoth
lines.text: We left Ray for a box of shells.

lines.speaker: mallCop
lines.text: Then let's make them count.

lines.speaker: skater
lines.text: Ray's barely breathing, dude. Fast fight.

lines.speaker: biker
lines.text: Fast is my only speed.

lines.speaker: mallGoth
lines.text: Nobody's coming. It's just us.

lines.speaker: mallCop
lines.text: ...Then it's just us. Weapons up.

lines.speaker: butcher
lines.text: Take a number! I'll carve you one!

lines.speaker: butcher
lines.text: Three hundred a month... just to count heads.

lines.speaker: mallGoth
lines.text: Card in his apron. OSCS. Field Observer 4.

lines.speaker: skater
lines.text: Dude. The door log's printing.

lines.speaker: mallCop
lines.text: I let these men on the roof. I locked the doors.

lines.speaker: ray
lines.text: Fog crew went up at 11:30. You walked them, man.

lines.speaker: ray
lines.text: Badge... the bug guys...

lines.speaker: mallGoth
lines.text: Ray tried to tell us. At the counter.

lines.speaker: biker
lines.text: Not your fault, Badge.

lines.speaker: mallCop
lines.text: I called the number on my card. I told them four.

lines.speaker: mallGoth
lines.text: And they sent rifles. So much for help.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.text: Those men aren't here to help you. I am.

lines.speaker: mallCop
lines.text: Gate's sealed. Nobody leaves without a receipt.

lines.speaker: mallGoth
lines.text: Hear that? They're slow-dancing with the PA. Move.

lines.speaker: biker
lines.text: I said THROUGH 'em, not AROUND 'em! Rev it!

lines.speaker: mallCop
lines.text: No plan, no backup. Typical Friday. Stay tight.

lines.speaker: ray
lines.text: Hot pizza, coming through!

lines.speaker: mallGoth
lines.text: That's what help looks like? Rifles?

lines.speaker: mallCop
lines.text: Those are rifles. That is not help.

lines.speaker: biker
lines.text: Gas masks and rifles. That ain't help.

lines.speaker: skater
lines.text: Dude. Why's their help got guns?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Black Friday, 1994. Midnight Madness at Paragon Crossing.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At 12:01 AM, something came out of the air vents.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: WING 1: THE FOOD COURT. Sticky tile, fryer smoke, and a TV left on.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The shoppers who dropped here are getting back up.
